rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when something cannot be seen, including a detail that does not show on the surface.

example.english: The tiny writing in the photo is invisible.
example.traditional: 張相入面啲細字太矇，睇唔到。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 soeng2 jap6 min6 di1 sai3 zi6 taai3 mung4 tai2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when a person or object is inherently or deliberately invisible rather than merely out of sight.

example.english: Wearing this invisible cloak, I could walk into the crowd unnoticed.
example.traditional: 着住呢件隱形斗篷，行入人群都冇人睇到我。
example.jyutping: zoek3 zyu6 ni1 gin6 jan2 jing4 dau2 pung4 haang4 jap6 jan4 kwan4 dou1 mou5 jan4 tai2 dou3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for an app or chat status that hides the user while they are still online.

example.english: I’m invisible on the app tonight, but I can still see your messages.
example.traditional: 我今晚開住隱身，照樣睇到你哋啲訊息。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan1 hoi1 zyu6 jan2 san1 ziu3 joeng2 tai2 dou2 nei5 dei6 di1 seon3 sik1
